title: First Fruits
lead: The first ripe produce of each harvest belonged to God and was brought to the sanctuary (Exodus 23:19; Leviticus 23:10–14; Deuteronomy 26:1–11). The New Testament uses the image for Christ raised "the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep" (1 Corinthians 15:20) and for believers as God's first fruits (James 1:18; Revelation 14:4).
